title: wrapt workshops
description: Guided JupyterLab workshops for wrapt: writing decorators, and monkey patching.

collections.title: Decorators with wrapt
collections.description: Guided JupyterLab workshops on writing decorators with wrapt: the wrapper signature, methods, arguments, state, and the decorators wrapt bundles, each beside the standard library version it replaces.

collections.title: Monkey patching with wrapt
collections.description: Guided JupyterLab workshops on patching code you did not write with wrapt: every kind of method, taking a patch out again, temporary patches, getting there before the import, and wrapping what is not a function, each on a shipped package open beside the notebook.
